title: A Scalable Real-Time Data Assimilation Framework for Predicting Turbulent Atmosphere Dynamics
problem: AI foundation models for weather prediction lack real-time data assimilation systems to incorporate Earth system observations, preventing accurate forecasting of extreme events like tropical cyclones and atmospheric rivers.
motivation: Enabling real-time data assimilation in AI weather models requires supercomputer-scale systems, essential for operationalizing weather and climate predictions.
method: The framework combines an ensemble score filter (EnSF) for data assimilation with a vision transformer-based surrogate that adapts in real-time by integrating observational data. The system is validated on a benchmark surface quasi-geostrophic turbulence system with strong and weak scaling demonstrations to 1024 GPUs on the Frontier exascale supercomputer.
key_novelty: A scalable real-time data assimilation framework combining ensemble score filtering with vision transformer surrogates for operational weather prediction on exascale systems.
contributions: Generic real-time data assimilation framework for AI weather models
Ensemble score filter significantly outperforming LETKF
Vision transformer-based surrogate with real-time observational adaptation
Exascale demonstration with strong and weak scaling to 1024 GPUs on Frontier

metrics.speedup: strong and weak scaling to 1024 GPUs

limitations: Tested only on benchmark SQG turbulence system, not full-scale weather prediction with real foundation models.
primary_theme: Exascale real-time data assimilation for weather models
